Reason for submitting the bill

The purpose of the Government in submitting this bill is to develop the real estate business sector of the Maldives in a sustainable manner, to strengthen that business, and to set out the principles under which that business will operate within a transparent and accountable system; to set out the principles for registering developers active in the real estate business, the responsibilities and rights of those parties, and the principles for protecting the interests of parties who buy units developed by real estate projects; to establish a system for monitoring those parties and activities in order to ensure that all parties active in the real estate business continue to act in accordance with the relevant principles and standards; and to determine and set out fair real estate market rules and principles under a sound legal framework.

Chapter One
Preliminary

Introduction and title
1. (a) This is an Act setting out the principles for issuing licences to developers active in the real estate business, determining the responsibilities of those parties in conducting real estate projects, the principles for registering real estate projects, the principles for protecting the interests of parties who buy units developed by real estate projects, the principles relating to parties active in the real estate business sector, and all principles and provisions relating to the real estate business, in order to strengthen the real estate business sector of the Maldives and pave the way for that business to proceed in a highly transparent manner.

(b) This Act shall be cited as the "Real Estate Business Act".

Chapter Two

Basis of the terms

The terms set out in this Act are, in accordance with the principle set out in this Chapter, statements of terms identified and used consistently with the purpose of this Act, without contradicting the basic principles of this Act. Furthermore, every provision of this Act shall be read in a manner that does not narrow those terms.

Real estate
4. "Real estate" means land, including buildings, structures, fixtures, minerals in the land, and natural resources such as water and vegetation, together with changes or improvements attached to or permanently made to that land, and the legal rights attached to that land or to improvements made to that land. That meaning includes the rights of acquiring ownership, use, leasing, sale and development. It includes the rights, interests and benefits that exist in or arise from ownership of the land and

Real estate project
5. "Real estate project" means a project conducted for the purpose of developing land for residential purposes, or commercial purposes, or industrial purposes, or for more than one of those purposes.

6. "Building" means a place within a real estate project where land is developed for residential purposes, or commercial purposes, or industrial purposes, or for more than one of those purposes.

Common areas
7. "Common areas" means the places outside the boundaries of the individual properties included in a building or buildings developed within a real estate project, in which all owners of those properties hold equal shares. In addition to the places designated as common areas in a real estate project, this includes the foundation, columns, beams, stairs, lift system and ventilation [?] of the building.

8. "Common facilities" means the common facilities included within the common areas designated in a real estate project, and the common services [?] shared by all owners of the properties outside the building.

Property

"Property" means a property included in a building developed for residential purposes, or commercial purposes, or for more than one of those purposes, in which a freehold right or a leasehold right is sold or owned. Management corporation
